description_en: Queries a list of intelligent jobs based on specified parameters
description_zh: 根据用户所给参数，返回所有符合条件的任务列表
kebab_example: aliyun ice list-smart-jobs --next-token 000073f33c91-d59383e8280b0000 --max-results 10 --page-no 1 --page-size 10 --job-type ASR --sort-by CreationTime:Desc --job-state Finished --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListSmartJobs

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries to return.

Default value: 10. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh:
本次请求所返回的最大记录条数。

最大值：100，默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，每页显示条数。默认值为10，最大值为100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The job type.

Valid values:

ASR: automatic speech recognition(job) job.

DynamicChart: dynamic chart job.

VideoTranslation: video translation job.

TextToSpeech: intelligent audio production job
parameters.name: job_type

parameters.help_en:
The sorting parameter. By default, the query results are sorted by creation time in descending order.

Valid values:

CreationTime:Asc: sorted by creation time in ascending order.

CreationTime:Desc: sorted by creation time in descending order
parameters.help_zh: 排序参数，默认根据创建时间倒序
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en:
The job state.

Valid values:

Finished: The job is complete.

Failed: The job failed.

Executing: The job is in progress.

Created: The job is created
parameters.name: job_state
